answer: Gate earning behind a verifiable delay: before a head may submit, it must finish a sequential hash chain that provably consumes wall-clock minutes and cannot be parallelized. The delay calibrates so one newcomer waits briefly, but the parameter scales with how many heads share a tier, so k clones each pay k times the delay every epoch. Attestations then flow through a lagoon partition where peers see only a slice, blocking coordinated cosign plots. A crystal-hard zenith cap on weighable history per head stops a fleet from amplifying one honest source into many voices.
